summary: Frontend regression testing completed for the updated ATELIER portfolio. Required sections, Turkish service copy, five logo marks, project metadata/images, Plus Jakarta Sans rendering, hover affordances, navigation, mobile menu, and desktop/tablet overflow passed. Mobile logo showcase is not a balanced two-column grid because the fifth tile spans both columns.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px mobile width, logo tiles 1-4 are approximately 168px wide while tile 5 spans both columns at approximately 343px. This conflicts with the requested balanced 2-column mobile grid.

action_items: Remove the mobile last-child grid-column span (or otherwise keep all five logo tiles within a consistent two-column tile width) and retest the 390px layout.
Retest the previously reported backend /api/contact empty-string validation issue separately; backend was intentionally not tested in this frontend-only iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: The @media max-width:700px rule explicitly sets .logo-tile:last-child to grid-column:span 2, which directly creates the unbalanced mobile showcase identified by the requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1920px and tablet 768px logo grids were five and three columns with equal tile widths; mobile 390px has two columns but the fifth tile spans both columns. Hover arrow/underline, rendered Plus Jakarta Sans-only fonts, no italic/em elements, project images, Behance links, nav scrolling, mobile menu, and no horizontal overflow passed. Prior iteration's backend contact validation issue remains outside this run.
rca of the issue: The mobile CSS intentionally applies .logo-tile:last-child{grid-column:span 2;aspect-ratio:2/1}, making the fifth item full-width instead of preserving the requested balanced two-column tile geometry.
